nodes.label: Microsoft
nodes.relation: Azure buys NVIDIA racks for itself and for OpenAI and Anthropic workloads
nodes.summary: Microsoft guided fiscal 2027 capex to about $170 billion while saying it will stay free cash flow positive.
brief: Largest Azure GPU buyer
Its fiscal 2027 budget is the clearest single read on next year's rack orders.
nodes.health: Guides about $170 billion fiscal 2027 capex and still expects positive free cash flow.

nodes.label: Amazon
nodes.relation: AWS buys NVIDIA systems but is pushing its own Trainium chips
nodes.summary: Amazon holds about $220 billion of 2026 capex and plans meaningfully more in 2027, but more of it goes to Trainium.
brief: Biggest cloud, Trainium maker
Its spend keeps rising, but a growing share flows to its own chips.
nodes.health: Trailing free cash flow is negative $42.4 billion on about $220 billion of 2026 capex.

nodes.label: Alphabet
nodes.relation: Google Cloud runs Vera Rubin racks while selling its own TPU systems
nodes.summary: Alphabet kept 2026 capex at $195 to $205 billion and said 2027 will rise significantly, with TPU systems a growing product.
brief: Hyperscaler and TPU rival
One of the largest GPU buyers and also the strongest custom chip alternative.
nodes.health: Free cash flow was negative $9.1 billion in Q3 on $51.4 billion of capex.

nodes.label: Meta
nodes.relation: Buys Vera Rubin, Vera CPUs and Spectrum-X for its own models
nodes.summary: Meta spent $34.9 billion of capex in Q3 and went cash flow negative for the first time since 2012.
brief: Largest non-cloud GPU buyer
Spends only for itself, so its willingness to burn cash sets its orders.
nodes.health: Q3 free cash flow was negative $2.1 billion, with long-term debt at $80.9 billion.

nodes.label: Oracle
nodes.relation: OCI builds NVIDIA clusters, largely for OpenAI's Stargate sites
nodes.summary: Oracle has a $664 billion backlog and is paying for the buildout with negative free cash flow and a $20 billion share sale.
brief: OpenAI's main cloud builder
The most leveraged big buyer, so financing strain shows up here first.
nodes.health: Q1 free cash flow was negative $5.4 billion on $28.5 billion of capex.

nodes.label: CoreWeave
nodes.relation: GPU cloud built almost entirely on NVIDIA hardware, partly NVIDIA-owned
nodes.summary: CoreWeave raised 2026 capex to $37 to $39 billion on a $132.5 billion backlog, financed mostly with debt.
brief: Largest independent GPU cloud
A pure NVIDIA buyer whose orders depend on debt markets staying open.
nodes.health: Carries nearly $47 billion of debt and lost $709 million in Q3.

nodes.label: OpenAI
nodes.relation: End customer behind Stargate, Oracle and CoreWeave capacity; NVIDIA backs its Ohio campus
nodes.summary: OpenAI's compute plans are the single biggest demand driver, but it loses more than it earns and needs new money by 2028.
brief: Largest AI lab compute buyer
Much of Oracle's and CoreWeave's NVIDIA demand ultimately rests on OpenAI paying.
nodes.health: Q3 revenue of $10 billion against a $10.9 billion operating loss.

nodes.label: Anthropic
nodes.relation: Rents compute through Google, Amazon and Microsoft; NVIDIA expanded its GPU access
nodes.summary: Anthropic's IPO filing shows about $895 billion of compute commitments, with the biggest slices tied to Google TPUs and Amazon.
brief: Fast-growing lab, TPU-heavy
Shows how much frontier lab demand can flow to custom chips instead of GPUs.
nodes.health: Q3 revenue near $17 billion with a $567 million operating loss, per its filing.

nodes.label: Humain
nodes.relation: Saudi PIF-owned AI company buying Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems
nodes.summary: Humain expanded its NVIDIA deal to up to 84 megawatts, about 27,000 GPUs, with a US client taking most of it.
brief: Saudi sovereign AI buyer
Sovereign demand is outside the hyperscaler budget cycle, which spreads NVIDIA's risk.
nodes.health: Backed by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, targeting about 3GW of capacity by 2030.

nodes.label: SB Energy
nodes.relation: SoftBank-backed developer of OpenAI's Ohio campus, with NVIDIA guaranteeing the lease value
nodes.summary: NVIDIA guarantees up to $105 billion of residual lease value on SB Energy's 4.25GW Ohio campus leased to OpenAI.
brief: Builds OpenAI's Ohio campus
NVIDIA is now on the hook if OpenAI cannot pay its rent here.
nodes.health: NVIDIA invested $1.5 billion and guarantees up to $105 billion of its lease value.

signals.headline: Microsoft sees $170bn capex in fiscal 2027 but says it will stay cash flow positive
signals.whyItMatters: The largest buyer is raising its budget again and can fund it from cash, which supports next year's rack orders.
signals.evidence: expects to stay free cash flow positive this fiscal year

signals.headline: Google misses revenue expectations, Alphabet stock sinks in early after-hours trading
signals.whyItMatters: Alphabet promised a significant capex increase for 2027 even as the stock fell, so a second of the big four is still raising spend.
signals.evidence: continues to expect its capital expenditures to "increase significantly" in 2027

signals.headline: Alphabet's Q3 2026 results: search and cloud grow, free cash flow is negative
signals.whyItMatters: Google is now building inventory to sell TPU systems to others, which turns a buyer into a direct competitor for the same budgets.
signals.evidence: a buildup of inventory for TPU-system sales

signals.headline: AWS grows 39% and Amazon will spend even more on AI in 2027
signals.whyItMatters: A third hyperscaler says 2027 spend goes up, which makes the kill criterion of two cuts look far away.

signals.headline: Amazon plans to sell Trainium chips outside AWS starting late 2027
signals.whyItMatters: Trainium sold to outside buyers would compete with NVIDIA for the same AI clouds and labs, on top of AWS's own fleet.
signals.evidence: plans to start selling its Trainium AI chips outside AWS

signals.headline: Meta Platforms posts negative free cash flow for the first time since 2012
signals.whyItMatters: Meta is still spending hard on NVIDIA gear, but it is now funding that from its balance sheet rather than cash flow.

signals.headline: Oracle announces Q1 results driven by triple digit growth in cloud infrastructure revenues
signals.whyItMatters: A $664 billion backlog means many more NVIDIA clusters, but Oracle is paying for them with negative cash flow and a $20 billion share sale.
signals.evidence: RPO up $209 billion year-over-year to $664 billion

signals.headline: Oracle sends force majeure notice on its New Mexico Stargate data center
signals.whyItMatters: If the 2.45GW Jupiter campus slips past 2028 because of power delays, the NVIDIA racks meant for it slip too.

signals.headline: CoreWeave: record Q3 revenue reaches $3.66 billion as backlog grows to $132.5 billion
signals.whyItMatters: A growing backlog at a pure NVIDIA cloud turns almost one for one into GPU and networking orders.
signals.evidence: 2026 capital expenditures of $37 billion to $39 billion

signals.headline: OpenAI posts steep losses even as quarterly revenue rises to $10 billion, WSJ reports
signals.whyItMatters: Revenue is growing fast, but OpenAI still loses more than it books, and Oracle and CoreWeave orders depend on it paying.
signals.evidence: operating losses widened to $10.9 billion from $10.1 billion

signals.headline: OpenAI's compute plan rises to $856bn while its projected cash burn improves
signals.whyItMatters: OpenAI's compute plan is far bigger than its cash, so a weak funding round in 2027 or 2028 would hit NVIDIA demand through several clouds at once.
signals.evidence: on track to exhaust that by 2028

signals.headline: NVIDIA's Q3 filing shows up to $118 billion of credit guarantees, mostly for OpenAI's Ohio campus
signals.whyItMatters: NVIDIA is now providing credit support for a buyer's land, power and buildings, so part of its demand is propped up by its own balance sheet and an OpenAI default would land on NVIDIA.
signals.evidence: up to $105 billion supports guarantees for SB Energy's data center project in Ohio

signals.headline: Anthropic details long-term compute commitments in amended IPO filing
signals.whyItMatters: The fastest-growing lab is reserving its biggest new compute on Google TPUs, so that spend goes to a rival chip rather than NVIDIA.
signals.evidence: $125 billion to $150 billion for additional Google TPU compute

signals.headline: Saudi Arabia's Humain expands Nvidia deal with 84MW AI computing plan
signals.whyItMatters: Sovereign buyers add demand that does not depend on hyperscaler budgets, although this deal is small and not yet final.
signals.evidence: develop up to 84 megawatts of artificial intelligence computing capacity

signals.headline: NVIDIA's Q3 data center revenue splits $60.1 billion hyperscale and $47.5 billion AI cloud, industrial and enterprise
signals.whyItMatters: Non-hyperscale buyers grew 195% against 71% for hyperscalers, so revenue is less concentrated in the big four than a year ago.
signals.evidence: AI cloud, industrial and enterprise customers contributed $47.5 billion
